philosophyQuotes.quote: Architecture is the art of how to waste space.
philosophyQuotes.author: — Philip Johnson

philosophyQuotes.quote: The details are not the details. They make the design.
philosophyQuotes.author: — Charles Eames

philosophyQuotes.quote: Space is the breath of art.
philosophyQuotes.author: — Frank Lloyd Wright

philosophyQuotes.quote: A great building must begin with the unmeasurable, pass through measurable means when it is being designed, and in the end must be unmeasurable.
philosophyQuotes.author: — Louis Kahn
